context: Linked interactive data visualization — parallel coordinates chart brushed to filter 40 world cities across 6 dimensions, with a synchronized world map showing selected cities as glowing dots
first_impression: Cohesive dark-mode design with a deliberate single-accent palette and clear typographic hierarchy that reads as intentional rather than default
what_works: Disciplined single-hue accent (#6ab4ff) used consistently across both panels with appropriate opacity layering (0.06 ghost / 0.12 ambient / 0.7 selected) creates a clear visual hierarchy within the data itself; typographic hierarchy is well-considered — title at 18px/600 weight, subtitle quieted to 13px/#888, axis labels at 11px/600, ticks at 11px/#aaa
what_doesnt: Land/ocean contrast (#1a1a2e vs #0d1117) is so subtle the map geography nearly disappears in the screenshot, making it hard to read city positions spatially; city dots at 3px radius are small enough that dense regions (Europe, East Asia) blur together without brushing active
